filter.description:
Filter the files are in the search result.
- all: Displays all files in the Originals folder (default).
- used: Only displays files that are used in the project.
- unused: Only displays files that are not used in the project.

folder.description: Base folder for search relative to Originals folder. Default to the Originals folder.

recursive.description: Search in all subfolders of the base folder. Default to true.

return.description: Array of fields to return for each file or folder found.

items.description:
Fields to return for each file or folder found:
 - isUsed : Indicates if the file is used by a Wwise object. 
 - usage : List the Wwise objects that use this file. 
 - isMissing : Indicates if the file is absent in the source manager 
 - file : The files are in the list. 
 - folder : The folders are in the list.

objectReturn.descriptions: Array of return expressions for each object returned in the 'usage' field.

folder.description: Folder path relative to Originals folder.

file.description: File path relative to Originals folder.

isUsed.description: Indicates whether a file is used by a Wwise Object in the project.

usage.description: List of objects from the project that are using this file. (see objectReturn options)

isMissing.description: Indicates that the file exists in source control but is not present in the local file system.

items.description: Specifies what is returned for every item found.

examples.description: Return the absolute path of audio files that are not used by a Wwise object and all folders under the Originals folder.
examples.title: Retrieve all audio files in the projet

examples.description: Return the path of audio files that are not used by a Wwise object.
examples.title: Retrieve unused audio files in the projet

examples.description: Returns the absolute path of audio files in a folder.
examples.title: Retrieve all audio files in a specific folder
